offering_description.value: Eastman manufactures specialty plastics, performance films, chemical additives, industrial intermediates and cellulose acetate fibers. It supplies manufacturers, industrial formulators and distributors and uses molecular recycling to recover feedstock from plastic waste for some of its materials.

primary_products.value: specialty plastics; performance films and glazing interlayers; functional additives; industrial chemical intermediates; cellulose acetate fibers

customer_segment.value: B2B: automotive suppliers, plastics converters, coatings formulators, industrial chemical manufacturers and cigarette filter makers

end_markets.value: automotive and transportation; building and construction; consumer goods and packaging; industrial manufacturing; tobacco filtration

revenue_model.value: product sales: specialty plastics, films, additives, chemical intermediates and acetate fibers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts chemical feedstocks, cellulose and recovered plastics into materials for manufacturers and industrial formulators

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: advanced plastics and films, functional additives, chemical intermediates and cellulose acetate fibers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving manufacturers, converters and industrial formulators; distributors / dealers: specialty chemical distributors and independent dealers for automotive and architectural films

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: chemical production and handling subject to EPA environmental and chemical rules, OSHA safety standards and EU REACH
